name: Ab Comer（未见独立官方中文名称键）
relation_type: 帝国旧地/边界/市场/制度的直接文本提及
english_text: Ab Comer sits on the steep pass cut by the upper Trand river that climbs the Uchalion plateau. The tribes of this region grow grapes on the hillsides, used to make a white wine popular with the imperial and Vlandian aristocracies.
official_chinese_description: 阿布·科梅尔坐落于穿过乌卡利翁高原的特朗河上游的陡峭处。当地各部落会在山坡上种植葡萄，用以酿造一种深受帝国与瓦兰迪亚贵族欢迎的白葡萄酒。
dlc_text: Ab Comer sits on the Etircomb, the steep valley which climbs from the Vlandian coastal plain to the Uchalion plateau, cut by the small creeks feeding the Trand River. The tribes of this region grow grapes on the hillsides, used to make a white wine popular with the imperial and Vlandian aristocracies.

name: Llanoc Hen（未见独立官方中文名称键）
relation_type: 帝国旧地/边界/市场/制度的直接文本提及
english_text: Llanoc Hen sits in a ridge in the heights of the Uchalion massif. The villagers, known as skilled pig-farmers, look down two passes, the western one leading up from Vlandian lands and the eastern one leading up from the Empire.
official_chinese_description: 拉诺克·亨位于乌卡利翁地块的高山山脊处。村民们都是熟练的养猪户，他们下山后有两条路，一条向西通往瓦兰迪亚，另一条向东通往帝国。
dlc_text: Llanoc Hen sits at the foot of the Cafalcombe that climbs from the western imperial lands to the Uchalion massif. Oak and other trees grow thick in the valley, providing nuts and thick roots to feed the local hogs.

name: Cantrec（未见独立官方中文名称键）
relation_type: 帝国旧地/边界/市场/制度的直接文本提及
english_text: Cantrec sits in the rocky Glen of Balasog that climbs up from the imperial lands into the plateau of the Uchafion. The lands is not especially fertile here, but pigs thrive in the bush and shrubland of the heights.
official_chinese_description: 坎特雷克坐落于帝国领土通往乌喀利昂高原处多岩的巴拉索格峡谷之中。当地土壤并不十分肥沃，但高处的灌木林地很适合养猪。
dlc_text: Cantrec sits in the rocky Cafalcombe that climbs up from the imperial lands into the plateau of the Uchalion. The lands is not especially fertile here, but pigs thrive in the bush and shrubland of the heights.

name: Tepes（未见独立官方中文名称键）
relation_type: 帝国旧地/边界/市场/制度的直接文本提及
english_text: Tepes sits overlooking a tributary of the Karakaz, a river that flows from the north into Lake Tanaz, which the Empire calls Tanaesis. This district specializes in the harvest of timber which is floated down the river and sold to the lake towns.
official_chinese_description: 泰佩斯村俯瞰着喀拉卡孜河的一条支流，喀拉卡孜河自北方流入帝国人称作塔奈西斯的达那孜海。该地区盛产木材，人们顺流而下，将木材销往湖边的城镇。
dlc_text: Tepes sits in forested lowlands between the Devseg plateau and the lake that the Khuzaits call the Tanaz Sea. This district specializes in the harvest of timber, which is dragged by oxen to the water and then floated to the lake towns.

name: Ismilkorg（未见独立官方中文名称键）
relation_type: 帝国旧地/边界/市场/制度的直接文本提及
english_text: Ismilkorg sits on grassy downs between the Galcha and Vastra rivers, two small tributaries of the Miron. The people here are mostly cattle-herders as well as cattle-rustlers, and have long traded raids with the imperial frontier villages to the east and Battanians to the west.
official_chinese_description: 伊斯米尔科格坐落于弥戎河的两条小支流——加尔察河与瓦斯特拉河间长满草的低地上。当地人大多既养牛又偷牛，并长期劫掠东边的帝国边境村庄和西边的巴旦尼亚人。
dlc_text: Ismilkorg sits in the Irkaria hill country between Lake Laconis and the gulf that the Sturgians call the Battanian Sea. The people here are mostly cattle-herders as well as cattle-rustlers, and have long traded raids with the imperial frontier villages to the south and Battanians to the west.

name: Takor（未见独立官方中文名称键）
relation_type: 帝国旧地/边界/市场/制度的直接文本提及
english_text: Takor is a cattle raising village at the pass that the Battanians call Mynad Rhyfel, the mountain of war, and their imperial and Sturgian neighbors call Minador. It is one of the main trading and raiding routes between the wild north and the more settled imperial lands.
official_chinese_description: 塔科尔是一座养牛村，位于巴旦尼亚人称作“米纳德·里韦尔”，即“战争之山”的山口处。他们的帝国与斯特吉亚邻居们则称之为“弥那多耳”。这是连通荒凉北方与相对稳定的帝国疆土的主要通道之一，无论对商贸还是对劫掠来讲。
dlc_text: Takor is a cattle-raising village in the heart of the Chertyg Mountains. The term 'Takorski' is used by other Sturgians to refer to someone whose speech is unintelligible. Above the village, small wisps of smoke show where wandering Vakken forest dwellers make their temporary fields, sowing them for one or two seasons before moving elsewhere.

name: Hongard（未见独立官方中文名称键）
relation_type: 帝国旧地/边界/市场/制度的直接文本提及
english_text: Hongard sits in the warm wooded lands near the meandering Trand river. This land, rich in wheat and once the heartland of the Empire, is now the center of the Vlandian kingdom.
official_chinese_description: 翁加尔坐落于蜿蜒的特朗河附近的温暖林地。这片盛产小麦的土地曾是帝国的腹地，如今却成了瓦兰迪亚王国的中心。
dlc_text: Hongard sits in the warm wooded lands near the meandering Trand River. This region, rich in wheat and once the heartland of the Empire, is now the center of the Vlandian kingdom.

name: 阿斯·卡瓦尔
relation_type: 帝国旧地/边界/市场/制度的直接文本提及
english_text: Ath Cafal sits near the head of the Cafalcombe, a steep valley that descends to the imperial lands. Decent clay can be found in the small streams that rush down from the hills on all sides.
official_chinese_description: 阿斯·卡瓦尔靠近卡瓦尔谷——通往帝国领土的陡峭山谷之起始端。山上奔流而下的小溪中可以收集到优质的黏土。
dlc_text: Ath Cafal sits near the head of the Cafalcombe, a steep valley that descends to the imperial lands. The villagers gather fine clay from local streambeds to trade to the potters of nearby towns.

name: 布林·格拉斯
relation_type: 帝国旧地/边界/市场/制度的直接文本提及
english_text: Bryn Glas sits in a ridge in the eastern escarpment of the Uchalion massif. Villagers raise grapes on the slopes, making a strong, dark red wine highly valued by the Vlandians and the Empire.
official_chinese_description: 布林·格拉斯坐落于乌卡利翁地块东边的悬崖上。村民们在山坡上种植葡萄，酿造出浓郁的深红色葡萄酒，深受瓦兰迪亚人和帝国人的喜爱。
dlc_text: Bryn Glas sits on the eastern shores of the Llyn Tywal. Villagers raise grapes on the slopes, making a strong, dark red wine highly valued by the Vlandians and the Empire.

name: 维西布罗特
relation_type: 帝国旧地/边界/市场/制度的直接文本提及
english_text: Visibrot is a sheep-rearing village on the lower slopes of Mount Iltan, just below the network of glacial lakes known as the Iltan portages. Though this region is cold and remote, its importance as a trade juncture between Lakes Laconis and Tanaesis, between the Empire and the steppe, mean that it is relatively densely populated.
official_chinese_description: 维西布罗特是伊勒坦山缓坡上的一座养羊村，正好位于人称伊勒坦运输线的冰湖网络下。尽管该地区寒冷偏僻，但它作为拉科尼斯湖与塔奈西斯湖之间，帝国和草原之间贸易节点的重要性，仍使其拥有了相对稠密的人口。
dlc_text: Visibrot is a sheep-rearing village on the lower slopes of Mount Iltan. Though this region is cold and remote, its importance as a trade juncture between Lakes Laconis and Tanaesis, between the Empire and the steppe, mean that it is relatively densely populated.
